# "What to Test" for the next TestFlight build.
#
# Write the release's notes here as plain-words bullets, the same ones that go
# on the build's card in the command center. The staging pipeline uses this
# file only when it changed since the previous release; otherwise it falls back
# to summarising the feat/fix commits. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# App Store Connect allows at most 4000 characters.

• Confirm it's you is now part of Keyring for everyone, no longer behind a Developer switch. The request says who is asking and that "Not now" is fine. "Not now" puts off only that one request.
• Rooms open faster: a room shows the posts from your last visit straight away, and says when they are from last time, while Keyring checks for new ones. Private rooms are included. Keyring keeps this copy in your encrypted wallet on the phone. A post you have just sent no longer jumps when the list refreshes.
• Polls: the "Waiting for you" check asks all your communities at once. After you vote, the ballot closes as soon as your vote is saved, and sending carries on behind it. Leaving a community takes its polls off Messages straight away.
• Joining from other wallets' links: a community's join QR code made for any wallet, and its "choose a wallet" link, now open Join in Keyring.
• Keyring connects to your agent faster when it opens. A community whose address can't be reached now says so straight away instead of waiting.
• On a community's screen, if loading a new room invitation fails, Keyring tries once more a few seconds later.
Please check: on a fresh install, that a Confirm it's you request shows while Keyring is open; that a room you open shows its last posts at once; and, if you can, scan a community's join QR from its website.
